subject: Running Simulations in RStan: Memory Usage Issues?

messages.author: e66baf722e0aed3f
messages.subject: Running Simulations in RStan: Memory Usage Issues?
parts:
Hello all,

My apologies for an initially general inquiry, but does anyone have suggestions for how to effectively estimate models in RStan in a simulation context?

There have been several questions posted to a local listserv by students who report that only one or two models can be estimated before the system crashes as a result of running out of memory. It isn't clear what is being stored rather than overwritten when using RStan that results in such high memory usage.

Would a potential fix be to include a line or two of code, possibly to delete the model and then re-initialize the model within the loop?

Thank you very much,
Shauna

messages.author: dae01c57a3c54a3a
messages.subject: Re: [stan-users] Running Simulations in RStan: Memory Usage Issues?
parts: If there's lots of parameters and lots of iterations, the resulting stan_fit object might be fairly large to keep in memory, so you could simply save each stan_fit to file ("save(my_stanfit,file=paste(c(sim_iteration,".rdata"),sep=""))") then delete the stan_fit object from the environment ("rm(my_stanfit)") before re-running the model on new simulated data.
